text:
Yes, switch. Switching wins 2/3 of the time; staying wins 1/3.

This holds under the standard assumptions: the host knows where the car is, always opens a goat door you didn't pick, and always offers the switch. Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, and the host's reveal doesn't change that, so the remaining 2/3 collapses onto the other unopened door.

If the host picks randomly and only happened to reveal a goat, or offers the switch selectively, the odds change and switching may not help.
